properties.description:
Two suites, one capability.

`cargo test -p reflow2-core --test nothing_asks_what_a_session_made_false` — 10 cases on the computation.
`python3 tools/test_loop_nudge.py` — the `AsksWhatWasMadeFalse` case set inside the file's 91.

THE CASE THE HOOK HALF IS JUDGED ON is `test_it_never_arms_a_nudge_by_itself`. Anthony chose ask-don't-block deliberately, and every other assertion in that set would pass on an implementation that blocked. That one would not.

WHAT THE COMPUTATION PINS, each because getting it wrong is silent rather than loud:
  • A closed observation, an already-claimed one, a Verification, and an unanchored one are each excluded — separately, so a single over-broad filter cannot pass by accident.
  • `a_check_is_never_raised_as_a_candidate` is what keeps this from reversing `dec:verification-freshness-not-a-gap`.
  • `work_that_touched_nothing_anchored_says_so_rather_than_saying_nothing` — `subjects_examined: 0` distinguishes "nothing to check" from "checked, all clear". A short list and a blind one look identical without it.
  • `an_event_id_that_names_nothing_is_reported_not_skipped` — a typo would otherwise return an empty shortlist, the most reassuring answer available.
  • `it_reaches_an_observation_anchored_the_other_way_round` — both `HAS_TEMPORAL_FACT` and `ABOUT_ENTITY` are in live use, and reading one would halve coverage while looking like it worked.
  • `it_is_a_candidate_and_never_a_verdict` — asking closes nothing.

WHAT THE DELIVERY HALF PINS: the ride-along preserves the host message; an empty shortlist adds nothing; a long one names three and COUNTS the rest; ChangeEvent ids are captured from the call's own input, deduplicated, and bounded at 25; and an ask the last session never heard surfaces once at the next SessionStart.

BEYOND THE SUITES — exercised end to end on real data through the built binary over stdio, against the whole committed export (3,096 nodes / 13,231 edges) rather than a fixture, because the bug this family exists to prevent only appears at scale.
properties.findings:
`cargo test -p reflow2-core --test nothing_asks_what_a_session_made_false` — **10 passed, 0 failed**, 0.07s.
`python3 tools/test_loop_nudge.py` — **91 passed, 0 failed** (was 80), ~25s.
Both run unpiped with the exit code captured on its own line.

⭐ EXERCISED END TO END ON REAL DATA, through the built binary over stdio against the whole committed export (3,096 nodes / 13,231 edges) rather than a fixture — because the class of bug this family exists to prevent only appears at scale, and a rollup that walks the graph has shipped past ten green tests on twelve-node fixtures before on this project. Results: `chg:stop-hook-asks-the-graph` → 1 candidate from 7 subjects; `chg:the-repair-capability-gets-its-thread` → 6 from 2; `chg:bl89` → 40 from 8; a typo'd id → `unknown_events` named and `count: 0`. Warm calls 0.03–0.04s.

🛑 AND THAT RUN IS WHAT CAUGHT THE MEASUREMENT ERROR, which no unit test would have. The counts came back far higher than the design note predicted, because the note's "78% silent, median 1" was measured against an EDGE-ONLY reader covering 56% of observations, while the shipped computation reads `subject_id` too and covers 97%. Re-measured against the real implementation: **71% silent, median 1, mean 4.3, p90 13, max 40.** The conclusion survived; the number did not. Every doc comment, the tool description, the skill and the test's own header were corrected to the honest figures.

⚠️ NOT COVERED BY EITHER SUITE, and stated rather than implied: nobody has yet watched a session be shown a shortlist and act on it. Both suites prove the computation and the plumbing; whether the shortlist is USEFUL is a field question, and the ask-don't-block choice exists precisely so that question can be answered before the trigger is allowed to interrupt anyone.
properties.name: The ask surfaces what was touched, judges nothing, and never blocks
